item.title: China! We’ve added a Beijing show to our tour next month. We’ll be at @vas_live…
item.description:
China! We’ve added a Beijing show to our tour next month. We’ll be at @vas_live_official Shanghai on 23 Oct and OMNISPACE Beijing on 25 Oct. It’s our first visit to China and we’d love to see you. Especially if you are a panda. But humans also are welcome.
Tickets for both shows go on sale this Fri 18 Sep at 12PM China Standard Time 🇨🇳
中国的朋友们！我们下个月的巡演新增了一场北京站演出。我们将于 10 月 23 日在上海 VAS Live 演出，并于 10 月 25 日在北京 OMNISPACE 演出。这是我们首次来华，非常期待见到大家——尤其是如果你是只熊猫的话（当然，人类朋友我们也同样欢迎）。
两场演出的门票将于本周五（9 月 18 日）中午 12:00（中国标准时间）正式开售 🇨🇳

item.description:
Surprise! Our friend, producer and fellow Kiwi @nikbrinkman remixed “Metal” and it’s out today. Listen via the link in bio 🎧
Also, our final US tour of 2026 starts Friday! We’re playing @riot_fest and @allthingsgo, and all headline shows will be “by request” shows where YOU pick the set list as we go, via various elaborate systems. What could possibly go wrong?
Tix and tour dates at thebeths.com and all the usual places 🎟️

item.title: 🪈 Announcing our very, very last US shows for 2026! 🪈
item.description:
🪈 Announcing our very, very last US shows for 2026! 🪈
Catch us live in Chicago @concordhall on Fri 18 Sep for a @riot_fest After Show (with @lunar_vacation), plus ‘by request’ shows in Brooklyn @musichallofwb on Wed 23 Sep and Los Angeles @sidthecat on Wed 14 Oct! Our good friend @iamchelseajade will support.
Presale starts NOW using code BYREQUEST. General onsale tomorrow, Fri 14 Aug @ 10AM local.
PIONEERTOWN UPDATE: Sadly we’ve had to move our @pappyandharriets show to Thu 15 Oct [cue sad recorder noise 🪈]. All tickets will be honoured for the new show date - but if you can’t make it, you can request a refund from point of purchase. Thanks and sorry!
Note: festival sets won’t be full ‘By Request’ format
item.content:encoded:
🪈 Announcing our very, very last US shows for 2026! 🪈

Catch us live in Chicago @concordhall on Fri 18 Sep for a @riot_fest After Show (with @lunar_vacation), plus ‘by request’ shows in Brooklyn @musichallofwb on Wed 23 Sep and Los Angeles @sidthecat on Wed 14 Oct! Our good friend @iamchelseajade will support.

Presale starts NOW using code BYREQUEST. General onsale tomorrow, Fri 14 Aug @ 10AM local.

PIONEERTOWN UPDATE: Sadly we’ve had to move our @pappyandharriets show to Thu 15 Oct [cue sad recorder noise 🪈]. All tickets will be honoured for the new show date - but if you can’t make it, you can request a refund from point of purchase. Thanks and sorry!

Note: festival sets won’t be full ‘By Request’ format
